t: Contemporary electric shower with advanced pressure stabilised control which keeps the temperature consistent. Airboost technology offers a powerful shower experience, increasing the flow of water by up to 30% without using any more water. Features include Sensi-flo, Clearscale and Dual Element technology. Sensi-flo delivers protection against sudden surges of hot water if there is ever a blockage in the showerhead or hose that suddenly clears. Clearscale and Dual Element technology reduce limescale build-up increasing lifetime of shower. A phased shutdown flushes hot water from the tank making it safe for the next user. Includes a large 4-spray showerhead, rub-clean nozzles and smooth hose for easy cleaning.
b: Suitable for Cold Mains Water Only
